column2: A duplicate charge appeared on my credit card after I paid for groceries.
The bank closed my current account without explaining why and has not returned the remaining balance.
My mortgage payment was processed, but the servicer still added a late fee.
A debt collector keeps calling about an account that does not belong to me.
My credit report contains an address and loan that I do not recognise.
The lender has not applied my vehicle-loan payment to the outstanding balance.
A transfer sent through a payment service never reached the recipient.
The card issuer said \pay today\", even though the disputed purchase is still under investigation."
The ATM recorded a cash withdrawal, but no cash was dispensed and my bank rejected the dispute.
The company reported the same collection twice; I asked both the collector and credit bureau to correct it.
